target: Public reader navigation and product surface hierarchy

contract.purpose: Reduce the public shell to the one daily brief, its evidence, and its measured history.
contract.purposeSource: Site Health purpose contract, PRODUCT.md, and docs/product/prd.md
contract.canonicalPurpose: High Signal turns scattered technology, startup, finance, and market sources into one evidence-backed daily intelligence brief.
contract.audience: A curious operator who wants decision-relevant changes without reading every feed and article.
contract.job: Read the current brief, inspect a claim's evidence, and check how comparable calls performed.
contract.thesis: Three reader destinations make one product legible: Brief, Signals, and Track record.
contract.system: Preserve the existing Evidence Terminal typography, spacing, rules, and restrained cyan accent.
contract.signature: The claim-to-proof-to-outcome path stays visible while source and research machinery moves backstage.
contract.risk: Useful research routes could become harder to discover, so they remain addressable and contextually linked without appearing as peer products.

projectCheck.command: pnpm quality; pnpm build; PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=3011 pnpm --dir apps/web exec playwright test e2e/nav.spec.ts e2e/app-health.spec.ts

findings: The global header now exposes only Brief, Signals, and Track record at all exact widths 390, 768, and 1440 without overflow.
The footer keeps source proof, methodology, policies, API feeds, live analytics, repository, and RSS access while removing research, operator, portfolio, and roadmap promotion.
The former all-features directory redirects to the Brief and is absent from the public discovery registry; contextual research routes remain directly addressable.

ownerFeedback.note: The agent selected the direction; no owner approval was required.
